# Modified CocoaSpice for Astra Parallel

This is the macOS SPICE viewer used by Astra, based on utmapp/CocoaSpice revision `127033fa3e59cd49678f49ed54f8adfc060afb56`. It includes native audio playback, relative input, display-copy recovery, and bounded opt-in text clipboard integration. Required SPICE/GLib/GStreamer dependency headers are retained.

See [the Astra build guide](../../docs/building.md) for the pinned framework inputs and supported build command. Original Apache-2.0 and header notices remain intact in LICENSE and the source files.
